name: app-mobile-app-overview-long-board-with-hand-and-pearl-screens
title: Long white board: hand-held onboarding then home, analytics, card, transfer, details, choose-a-card and swap screens in pearl glass
whatItIs: A tall off-white board '12 Mobile App' opening with a large hand holding a phone with a pearl onboarding, then screens with side captions: home dashboard, analytics with mirrored bars, manage cards with a fluted pearl card, money transfer keypad, a hand-held transaction details chart, choose a card and asset swap.
whatItMeans: Refined and airy; pearl glass and serif figures make a banking app feel private.
techniques: Open with a hand-held hero photo.
Alternate phone left and right with short captions.
Show a hand mid-flow for detail.

vocabulary.definition: Titles and descriptions placed beside alternating phones.
A large photo of a hand holding the device.
Bars above and below a centre line.
